arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unlabelled_transactions FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.transaction_id IS NULL
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions that have no matching row in fraud_labels, out of all transactions.
assumptions: 'No fraud label at all' means no row in fraud_labels for that transaction id, regardless of is_fraud value.
Counted across the full transactions table, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
